_open_blockers.provider_quota: CRITICAL AND FIRST: the configured Gemini key is free tier, 20 requests/day/model (quotaId GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier). A judged round exhausts this in minutes, after which every request silently falls back to the deterministic interpreter, which does not satisfy the mandatory-LLM requirement. Enable billing on the Google Cloud project, or add a key from a different vendor, BEFORE deploying.
